claims.text: The hotel has direct access to the Central Embassy mall and Ploenchit station on the BTS Skytrain.

findings.quote: In the heart of Bangkok with direct access to Central Embassy, a world-class luxury mall and Ploenchit station on the BTS skytrain.

claims.text: The pool is a saltwater pool with an infinity-edge lap-swimming section.

findings.quote: This 40-meter saltwater pool, featuring a 25-meter infinity edge lap-swimming section

claims.text: The spa is PANPURI WELLNESS, which offers organic treatments.

findings.quote: PAÑPURI WELLNESS at Park Hyatt Bangkok reveals a world of utmost indulgence. Offering an elegant environment and luxurious organic treatments

claims.text: The gym has cardiovascular, strength and weight-training equipment by Technogym.

findings.quote: the gym houses a full range of cardiovascular, strength and weight-training equipment by Technogym.

claims.text: Room interiors use calming natural materials with Thai accents.

findings.quote: featuring a backdrop of calming natural materials punctuated with timeless Thai accents.

claims.text: Bathrooms have a separate soaking bathtub and rain shower, with Le Labo amenities.

findings.quote: feature a separate soaking bathtub and rain shower; an illuminated make-up mirror; and bathroom amenities by New York brand Le Labo.

claims.text: Penthouse Bar + Grill offers a New York-inspired evening of live entertainment, cocktails and classic steakhouse dining.

findings.quote: Penthouse Bar + Grill delivers a New York–inspired evening of live entertainment, vibrant cocktails, and classic steakhouse dining.

claims.text: At Penthouse Grill, meat and seafood are prepared over organic charcoal.

findings.quote: At Penthouse Grill on Level 34, premium cuts of meat and fresh seafood are expertly prepared over organic charcoal

claims.text: Penthouse Cocktail Bar has live jazz from Wednesday to Sunday.

findings.quote: From Wednesday to Sunday, live jazz fills the room with soulful rhythms

claims.text: Embassy Room La Marina serves Italian cuisine inspired by Italy's coastal regions.

findings.quote: Embassy Room La Marina focuses on capturing the essence of Italy’s coastal regions with a relaxed, yet refined atmosphere.
Savor classic Italian flavors with Embassy Room La Marina’s Sunday Brunch.

claims.text: The Living Room serves International and Thai comfort food, loose-leaf tea and barista-made coffee.

findings.quote: the Living Room invites diners to unwind with International and Thai comfort food as well as loose-leaf tea and barista-made coffee.

claims.text: An airport fast track service escorts guests through the priority diplomatic immigration line.

findings.quote: After exiting the airplane you will be greeted by our airport concierge and escorted through the priority diplomatic immigration line

claims.text: The hotel's meeting and event venues were designed by Yabu Pushelberg.

findings.quote: 12 versatile and inspiring venues designed by the celebrated Yabu Pushelberg.

claims.text: Penthouse Cocktail Bar has a vintage-motoring aesthetic and double-height ceilings.

findings.quote: Designed with a plush vintage-motoring aesthetic and soaring double-height ceilings

claims.text: The hotel holds 2 Michelin Keys in The MICHELIN Guide Hotels for 2024 to 2026.

findings.quote: 2024 – 2026 The MICHELIN Guide Hotels – 2 MICHELIN Keys

claims.text: The Rooftop Bar serves interactive cocktail experiences against Bangkok's skyline.

findings.quote: the Rooftop Bar serves interactive cocktail experiences set against the dramatic backdrop of Bangkok’s skyline.

claims.text: Spa experiences are not operated by Park Hyatt Bangkok and are not eligible for World of Hyatt points.

findings.quote: Kindly note that spa experiences are not eligible for World of Hyatt points as they are not operated by Park Hyatt Bangkok.

claims.text: The Executive Retreat at The Park is included with premium and specialty suites; for other room categories it is an optional package.

findings.quote: Offered as a complimentary inclusion with our premium and specialty suites or as an optional package for other room categories

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's exclusivity.
